preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges defining the tree structure.
The number of queries m is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 0 <= d <= 10**9 and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for v, d, x in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (v, d, x) has valid vertex index, non-negative distance, and positive value.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output_values[i] == sum(x for v, d, x in queries if is_ancestor(v, i+1) and dist(v, i+1) <= d) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each vertex i (1-indexed), the output value is the sum of x from all queries where v is an ancestor of i and the distance between v and i is at most d.
